## Presentation using Quarto

You can find the introductory information about making a presentation using Quarto from [the official guide](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs). You can also find the detailed options from [the reference page](https://quarto.org/docs/reference/formats/presentations/revealjs.html).

Besides, you can have a look at [my presentation example](presentation-example.html).
